name: ButtonGroup
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes AppicaUI (e.g. `ButtonGroup(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
Variants
examples.notes: Outlined variants overlap their borders into one hairline; filled ones keep a hairline gap.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-4") do
    %i[ primary primary_outline secondary soft outline destructive ].each do |variant|
      ButtonGroup(variant:) do
        Button { "Years" }
        Button { "Months" }
        Button { "Days" }
      end
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-center gap-4") do
    %i[ sm md lg ].each do |size|
      ButtonGroup(size:, variant: :outline) do
        Button { "Left" }
        Button { "Center" }
        Button { "Right" }
      end
    end
  end
end

Icon buttons
examples.notes: `icon: true` on the group makes every button square; label each one.
